name: Sega Game Gear
description: Sega's colour handheld, launched in Japan in 1990 and in the West in 1991. It is essentially a portable Master System with a backlit colour screen, which made it the main colour rival to the monochrome Game Boy. The backlight also drained six AA batteries in a few hours.

specs.graphics: 3.2" backlit colour LCD, 160 × 144, 32 colours on screen from 4,096

curiosities: A plug-in Master Gear Converter let it play Master System cartridges, because the hardware is so similar.
An optional TV Tuner accessory turned it into a portable colour television.
Its stereo sound is only available through the headphone jack; the built-in speaker is mono.
Its 8-bit Sonic the Hedgehog games were different games from the Mega Drive ones, not ports.
In 2000 Majesco re-released it in North America as a budget handheld, almost a decade after launch.
